# Redis: availability

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Redis availability endpoints allow operators to check database availability status. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact availability endpoint path. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact HTTP method and status codes returned. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact request/response schema for availability checks. Useful for agents monitoring Redis cluster health and preventing downtime from misconfigured availability settings.
